title: Shakira Dances With Tigers & Debuts ‘Dai Dai’ at U.S. Tour Kick-Off: Best Photos
contentText:
Shakira is back on the road, with the superstar kicking off the United States leg of her Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour with a bang on Saturday (June 13) and Sunday (June 14) in Los Angeles.

Dazzling the crowd at the Intuit Dome in Inglewood, California, for back-to-back shows over the weekend, the Latin pop icon’s production was full of color, fun visuals and, of course, her signature choreography. After opening with “La Huesera,” Shak moved through a sprawling setlist that also included “La Fuerte,” “Girl Like Me,” “Don’t Bother,” “Hips Don’t Lie,” “Soltera,” “Antología,” “Whenever, Wherever” and “She Wolf.” She also saved space to give new single “Dai Dai” its tour debut and perform Zootopia 2  soundtrack hit “Zoo” while surrounded with tiger dancers, as well as rile fans up with an encore performance of Billboard Hot 100 top 10 smash  “Shakira: Bzrp Music Sessions, Vol. 53.”

The Grammy winner’s busy weekend started even before the L.A. shows, with the star performing alongside Burna Boy at the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening ceremony in Mexico City. She’ll also help close out the tournament by taking the stage with BTS and Madonna for the World Cup Final’s first-ever halftime show in July.

Until then, the next performance on Shak’s tour is slated for June 17 in the Palm Springs area, after which she’ll travel through Atlanta, Miami, Boston and more U.S. cities before she embarks on a 12-night residency in Madrid. Her stateside tour leg follows a short break from touring earlier this year, before which the Grammy winner spent most of 2025 playing shows across North and Latin America.
